bonus.text: In Casablanca on 26 September 2026, B-Boy Billy and B-Girl El Mamouny won the Red Bull BC One Cypher Morocco, earning spots at the World Final in Toronto on 29 November.
The Moussem of Tan-Tan, on UNESCO's list since 2008, brings together more than thirty tribes from southern Morocco and northwest Africa for music, chanting, poetry and games.
In Marrakech's Jemaa el-Fna square, a UNESCO-listed cultural space, Gnaoua dancers and storytellers share the crowd with traditional dentists, fortune-tellers and henna artists.
